# Third-party components

- **sing-box v1.14.4** is distributed as a separate executable process and is licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later. The Windows build script downloads its official release, verifies the release archive SHA-256, and includes its upstream `LICENSE` file in the output. Upstream source/tag: <https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/tree/v1.14.4>.
- **Vazirmatn** is a Persian UI font from Google Fonts, distributed under the SIL Open Font License. The build script includes the upstream `OFL.txt` in the application output. Upstream source: <https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/vazirmatn>.

MIX-MOGHIMI is an independent product and is not affiliated with the sing-box project or its maintainers.
